composition: Ruined gate on a cliff promontory · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the landward path, the medieval Kastro of Skiathos sits on a narrow promontory, with the sea cliff on both sides. The stone gate and higher wall are on the near side, and small chapel buildings stand among ruined house foundations. The sky is clear, about 6 percent cloud, about 19.5°C, with wind near 22 km/h. Morning sun falls on the eastern cliff.
